mil5.2.6:1.2: Yo ajānanto pāṇātipataṃ karoti so balavataraṃ apuññaṃ pasavatīti.
mil5.2.6:1.5: Yadi bhante Nāgasena ajānitvā pāṇātipātaṃ karonto balavataraṃ apuññaṃ pasavati, tena hi: Anāpatti ajānantassāti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.2.6:1.6: Yadi anāpatti ajānantassa, tena hi: ajānitvā pāṇātipātaṃ karonto balavataraṃ apuññaṃ pasavatīti tam-pi vacanaṃ micchā.
mil5.2.6:1.7: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho duruttaro duratikkamo tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.2.6:2.1: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā: Yo ajānanto pāṇātipātaṃ karoti so balavataraṃ apuññaṃ pasavatīti.
mil5.2.6:2.2: Puna ca Vinayapaṇṇattiyā pi Bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ:
mil5.2.6:2.6: atthi mahārāja āpatti saññāvimokkhā, atthi āpatti no saññāvimokkhā;
mil5.2.6:2.7: yā 'yaṃ mahārāja āpatti saññāvimokkhā taṃ āpattiṃ ārabbha Bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ:
mil5.2.6:2.9: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
